content: The official 24/7 dry-run league fields four active strategies. Timmy Top 50 leads in net equity ($1,058.54) and realized throughput ($0.46/hr) on clean v3 telemetry. Timmy Top 20 delivers the family’s highest win rate (52.9%) but lower absolute returns. Both Cosmo & Wanda variants post 100% closed win rates yet carry heavy unrealized drag—Top 50 at −$36.62 across six stale runners and Top 20 at −$61.55 with no realized close since June 8—making exit architecture and universe breadth the central scouting priorities.
